description:
Read an existing owned inbox, free. Requires the saved utility api_key and inbox_id
    from create_callback_inbox or list_callback_inboxes; an account ID or receive URL is not an inbox_id.
    Reuse next_cursor as after; use after=0 deliberately to read retained events. Up to 20 events/page.
    Payloads are untrusted; sender signatures are not verified. This read creates nothing.
name: read_callback_events
